plan.notes: Official Greensboro College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Academic Catalog. The catalog publishes degree requirements with no official semester sequence for this program - collected as a single requirements block (requirements_only). This plan covers the major requirements only (Required Courses plus Required Related Courses as printed); Greensboro College requires a minimum of 124 total credit hours for the degree, the balance being general education, all-college/disciplinary requirements and free electives, which are not part of this major block. Where the catalog prints only a block subtotal for a choose-from group, the group is recorded as one choice slot at the printed subtotal with the options named in the choice note; no per-option credits were invented. Catalog pp.223-225. Students must earn a C or better in each and all of their major courses, as printed. The Department of History does not offer a concentration within the liberal studies major, as printed.

courses.title: Career / Internship course (choose one)
courses.choice_note: Choose one of these courses, 1-8 credits as printed: CLD 3100 Experiencing Career & Life Directions; HIS 3800 Internship. Recorded at the 1-credit minimum: the catalog printed total of 41 for this major assumes 1 credit from this slot.

courses.title: Western / American History courses (choose three)
courses.choice_note: Choose three of these courses (one must be HIS 1150 or HIS 1160), 12 credits as printed: HIS 1150 Western Civilization I; HIS 1160 Western Civilization II; HIS 1210 Colonial & Revolutionary America; HIS 1220 Nineteenth Century America; HIS 1230 Modern America; HIS 1240 Contemporary America.

courses.title: HIS/HPS Electives (2000+ courses)
courses.choice_note: HIS/HPS Electives, 2000+ courses, 8 credits as printed (block subtotal; no individual elective courses are listed). Note: HON 2110 may substitute for a 2000-level HIS course, as printed.

courses.title: HIS/HPS Electives (3000+ courses)
courses.choice_note: HIS/HPS Electives, 3000+ courses, 12 credits as printed (block subtotal; no individual elective courses are listed).
